items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CAMPAIGN (observed): L4D-style co-op hotel level; player 'Hengshan'; bots Coach, Ellis, Rochelle. Goal: find finale/extraction. No finale trigger found. Runs have looped repeatedly through floor 8 and back to the roof; no level transition yet.

CONTROLS (observed): WASD move, Shift sprint, Space jump, E opens doors/interacts, J = melee swing (with axe) or heal hold (with medkit), left-click = attack/swing, K = shove (never effective), 1/2 slots, arrow keys yaw/pitch slowly, mouse drag drives camera (inverted: drag up = look down). Identical repeated inputs stop registering; locks broken reliably by W+space (best), long S, or varied drags. Wall-hugging produces a bright flashlight disc centered on a surface = pinned; back off (S) then yaw. Letterbox/pitch can stick at ceiling (Down fixes) or floor (Up fixes).

COMBAT (observed): Specials seen: Charger (pins; 'Pinned! A teammate must help'; resisting with K/click/jump/movement fails; only long patience leads to bot revive), Jockey (rides; prompt 'Keep moving! Resist'; key finding: once a pistol is in hand, firing J killed the ride instantly; bots also shoot it off), Smoker (constricts; bots resolve), Boomer (pops into horde), Tank (killed Ellis once; must kite, never melee at low HP), Spitter (acid pools drain HP slowly). Commons at point-blank die to axe swings; hordes survived by swinging while backing off or letting bots gun them down. Friendly-fire warning if a teammate is under the crosshair.

HEALTH/REVIVE (observed): Bots auto-heal/revive me when I stand still near them, but bars progress erratically (stall ~35%, jump, stall ~90%, then complete after many waits). Coach healed me from ~28 to +80; Ellis healed to full 80. Incapacitation: 'Incapacitated! A teammate must help you' with ~300 bleed-out counter that often freezes or drifts (unreliable timer). Revive always eventually came after patience (10+ waits) with a full-but-stalled 'BEING REVIVED/HEALED' bar. After revive I rose with low HP. Once the near-death warning appeared: 'First aid needed! Next knockout means death...'. I died/incapped at least 4 times, always rescued because teammates stayed alive.

PICKUPS (observed, important): All item pickups are non-functional in this build: axe, medkit, magum pistol, Boomer bile, hammer. Prompts appear ('Trade melee weapon for magnum pistol', '<not bound> Select weapon/item', 'Get first aid') but E, J, F, slot keys, clicks, and walking onto them all fail. STOP testing pickups. Magnum only ever appeared when a weapon swap happened mid-ride.

FX (corrected): The white cross/crosshair circle is the flashlight reticle, NOT an objective marker. Blue glowing outlines through walls = teammate silhouettes, never items. Green/red arrow icons in the HUD mark objective direction.

NAVIGATION (observed): Roof has helipad+radio mast (fence-blocked), containers, leaning plank, ROOF ACCESS plaque door with card reader, and a stairwell with blue railings. Stairs descend to FLOOR 8 (plaque + card reader at landing; 'first aid/HELP' text). Floor 8 is a hotel: long checkered corridors, suites 800,801,802,803,804,800-area, SUITE A plaque, gym (chains, red bench, weights, ROOF ACCESS sign inside), bathrooms, keypad doors, STAIRS/EXIT signs, vending machines (COLD DRINKS, snacks), housekeeping room, banquet hall, lounge with balcony slider overlooking highway. Room 804 is a burning fire trap (fires everywhere, repeatedly incapped me; dead-end-ish; blue-framed side exit exists but hard to reach). A corridor-level broken window over the atrium caused a ledge hang (window = dead end). Windows have twice caused hangs; avoid. Balcony outside slider dead-ends at a white enclosure.

FAILED: melee/crouch/jump on barred boards and planks (leaning boards are indestructible scenery; go around edges); E on elevator/AC/meter boxes; trying to break cross-marked dressers; repeatedly pushing through room 804 fires.

ACTIVE GOAL/HYPOTHESES (guess): finale likely reached by continuing along floor-8 corridors to the lit far doorways (server/theatre-like areas) rather than returning to roof; the un-entered 'FLOOR 8' card-reader doorway and the descending stairwell remain the least-explored routes. Bots' movement and player-follow behavior are weak route evidence. Current state: full-ish health (~77), all three bots alive, in a blood-spattered floor-8 corridor near a lit doorway, after a possible Smoker constriction that appears to have ended.
